comment: Ranking of competing translations (fuzzy or conflicting library matches, ambiguous record prefill). A feature that cannot be measured is left out and the remaining weights are renormalised. A candidate is applied without a person only when its score reaches auto_apply_threshold, it leads the runner-up by auto_apply_margin, and the approval rules (approval-rules.json) also pass. Fuzzy candidates (different source text) are never applied unless auto_apply_fuzzy is true: a similar sentence is not the same sentence.
